title: Remove margin max is accepted, zero state is explained, and Cross orders can be placed
description: TAT-3985: on an isolated BTC testnet position (Trading account), add $20 margin, remove the offered Max and require exchange acceptance, then require the zero-removable explanation; re-validation is proven by focused tests. AC5: with perpsCrossMarginEnabled on, pick Cross in the Pro form and place a $15 SOL order that opens a Cross position (closed in teardown). AC6 (Lite trades an open Cross position) is proven by PerpsOrderView.view.test.tsx.

setup-session.intent: Select the funded Trading account on Hyperliquid testnet where the isolated BTC position lives

setup-assert-position.intent: Converge the isolated BTC long the margin flow acts on, opening one if the testnet account has none

setup-add-home.intent: Reset navigation so the market screen is the only margin entry point

setup-add-nav.intent: Open the BTC market holding the isolated position

setup-add-wait-margin-card.intent: Make sure the position margin card is mounted before opening margin actions

setup-add-press-margin-card.intent: Open the margin action choice for the position to add headroom

setup-press-add.intent: Choose Add Margin so the position has margin that can later be removed

setup-open-keypad.intent: Open the keypad to type the margin to add

setup-key-2.intent: Type the tens digit of the $20 addition

setup-key-0.intent: Type the units digit of the $20 addition

setup-close-keypad.intent: Close the keypad to reach the confirm button

setup-assert-added.intent: Confirm the exchange accepted the addition so removable headroom exists

ac1-home.intent: Reset navigation so the market screen is the only margin entry point

ac1-nav.intent: Open the BTC market holding the isolated position

ac1-wait-margin-card.intent: Make sure the position margin card is mounted before opening margin actions

ac1-press-margin-card.intent: Open the margin action choice for the position to remove the maximum

ac1-press-remove.intent: Choose Remove Margin as the user in the ticket does

ac1-open-keypad.intent: Reveal the quick-amount buttons including Max

ac1-press-max.intent: Select the maximum removable amount the app offers

ac1-close-keypad.intent: Close the keypad to show the summary and confirm button

ac1-wait-available.intent: Show the offered removable amount before submitting it

ac1-screenshot-max-form.label: AC1: Max amount offered for removal
ac1-screenshot-max-form.intent: Record the max removable amount the user is about to submit

ac1-press-confirm.intent: Submit the max margin removal to the exchange

ac1-assert-removed.intent: Confirm the exchange accepted the max removal the app offered

ac1-screenshot-removed.label: AC1: max removal accepted
ac1-screenshot-removed.intent: Show reviewers the exchange accepted the offered max amount

ac1-assert-no-rejection.intent: Confirm no exchange rejection toast followed the max removal

ac2-home.intent: Reset navigation so the market screen is the only margin entry point

ac2-nav.intent: Open the SOL market holding the freshly opened isolated position

ac2-wait-margin-card.intent: Make sure the position margin card is mounted before opening margin actions

ac2-press-margin-card.intent: Open the margin action choice for the position to check the zero state

ac2-press-remove.intent: Open Remove Margin on a position that has nothing left to remove

ac2-assert-explanation.intent: Confirm the user is told why no margin can be removed

ac2-screenshot-zero-state.label: AC2: zero removable explained, control disabled
ac2-screenshot-zero-state.intent: Show reviewers the remove control is disabled and explains why nothing can be removed

ac3-run-unit-tests.intent: Prove the pre-submit re-validation, headroom and cross-margin wiring through focused tests

ac3-assert-tests-pass.intent: Require the re-validation and headroom tests to pass

setup-sol-flat.intent: Start AC2 from no SOL position so the new one is freshly opened

setup-sol-open.intent: Open a fresh isolated SOL position whose margin sits at the transfer floor, leaving nothing removable

setup-sol-assert.intent: Require the fresh SOL position before opening its remove-margin screen

teardown-sol.intent: Close the SOL position this run opened so the account returns to its prior state

setup-cross-flag.intent: Turn cross margin on the way the remote flag rollout does

setup-cross-pro.intent: Reach the Pro SOL market where a new position's margin mode is still free

setup-cross-sol-flat.intent: Start AC5 with no SOL position so Cross can be picked

ac5-scroll-mode.intent: Bring the margin mode control on screen

ac5-open-mode.intent: Open the margin mode choice the PM could not use

ac5-wait-cross-option.intent: Show the Cross choice offered without the coming-soon note

ac5-screenshot-sheet.label: AC5: Cross offered in the margin mode sheet
ac5-screenshot-sheet.intent: Show reviewers Cross is selectable once the flag is on

ac5-pick-cross.intent: Choose Cross margin for the new order

ac5-assert-cross-label.intent: Confirm the order form now reads Cross

ac5-set-size.intent: Enter a $15 order through the size field

ac5-wait-submit.intent: Make sure the order can be submitted

ac5-assert-position-open.intent: Require the Cross order to open a SOL position

ac5-assert-cross-tag.intent: Confirm the new position is tagged Cross

ac5-screenshot-position.label: AC5: new SOL position tagged Cross, Reverse disabled
ac5-screenshot-position.intent: Show reviewers the order opened a Cross position

teardown-cross-sol.intent: Close the SOL position this run opened

teardown-cross-flag.intent: Return the flag to its default so later runs start clean

ac6-run-view-test.intent: Prove Lite trades an open Cross position in Cross when the flag is on, and still warns when it is off

ac6-assert-view-test-pass.intent: Require the Lite cross-margin view tests to pass

ac5-swipe-to-positions.intent: Move the positions list toward the viewport

ac5-swipe-to-sol-card.intent: Bring the new SOL position card on screen

setup-lite-mode.intent: Return to Lite so the market screen shows the position margin card, even after a previous run ended in Pro
